Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.x509

Record Class X509Properties

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.x509.X509Properties
Record Components:
enabled - whether the sign-in with a client certificate exists at all (default false).
forwardedHeader - name of the request header in which a trusted reverse proxy forwards the client certificate it verified (PEM, URL-encoded as $ssl_client_escaped_cert of nginx does, or the base64 of the DER form); empty (the default) turns the forwarded transport off.
trustedProxies - addresses or CIDR ranges of the proxies that may forward a certificate; required when the header is set, and a request from any other address never has its header read.
port - port of the dedicated TLS connector that requests a client certificate; 0 (the default) turns the direct transport off.
amr - RFC 8176 amr value the factor reports: sc (smart card, the default) or hwk (a hardware-bound key).
keyStore - path of the key store with the server certificate of the dedicated port; with the dev profile and none configured, a self-signed one is generated at the first start under ~/.irurueta-auth-server/.
keyStorePassword - password of the key store (and of its key), from the environment, never from a file.
keyStoreType - type of the key store (default PKCS12).
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="authserver.x509") public record X509Properties(boolean enabled, String forwardedHeader, List<String> trustedProxies, int port, String amr, String keyStore, String keyStorePassword, String keyStoreType) extends Record
Configuration of the sign-in with a client certificate (authserver.x509.*). It is off by default.

  • Constructor Details

    • X509Properties

      public X509Properties(@DefaultValue("false") boolean enabled, @DefaultValue("") String forwardedHeader, @DefaultValue List<String> trustedProxies, @DefaultValue("0") int port, @DefaultValue("sc") String amr, @DefaultValue("") String keyStore, @DefaultValue("") String keyStorePassword, @DefaultValue("PKCS12") String keyStoreType)
      Validates the configuration and copies the list.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the port is out of range, the amr value is not sc or hwk, a trusted proxy is not an address or a range, or a forwarded header is set without any trusted proxy.
